content.text: The insurance clause meets the preferred position in full.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 obliges Vendor (Cobalt Cloud) to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O of USD 2M and cyber/privacy of USD 5M, maintained throughout the term and for one year thereafter — matching the preferred position's limits and tail. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, primacy, cancellation notice and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, which is favourable to us. This exceeds the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and sits at the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
